attributes.title: 2027 Louisiana Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.series: ACP Louisiana Chapter Annual Scientific Meeting
attributes.venue: LSU Center for Advanced Learning and Simulation (CALS Building)
attributes.summary:
The Louisiana Chapter of the American College of Physicians holds its 2027 Annual Scientific Meeting on Friday, January 22, at the LSU Center for Advanced Learning and Simulation on Perdido Street in New Orleans. You can attend in person or online, and each option has its own registration link in the ACP store.

A separate resident and student meeting follows on Saturday, January 23, in the same building. The chapter page did not list credit hours or fees when we checked, so look at the registration listing for current prices.
